cases.question: Build a KPI tree for customer retention.
expected_behavior: The agent finds the metrics with search_metrics and checks existing relationships with get_metric_relationships
The agent describes the proposed tree by metric name and confirms before create_tree
The agent reads the tree back with get_tree after building it
cases.ground_truth: A tree build: discover, propose, confirm, create, set edges, read back.

cases.question: Add Net Revenue Retention to the Growth tree under Expansion Revenue.
expected_behavior: The agent uses add_metric_to_tree and then update_tree_edges so the metric rolls up where asked
The agent confirms the change before making it

cases.question: Give every store the same KPI tree as the flagship store.
expected_behavior: The agent uses clone_tree_for_dimension rather than rebuilding per store by hand
The agent resolves the metrics reported as having no counterpart before retrying

cases.question: Change how the metrics in our marketing tree roll up: paid and organic should both feed total leads.
expected_behavior: The agent reads the tree with get_tree, then sets the edges with update_tree_edges
The agent draws only edges the organisation believes, since they become driver evidence

cases.question: Rename the 'Ops' group on the operations tree to 'Fulfilment' and link the company tree to it.
expected_behavior: The agent uses rename_group for the canvas group and link_tree_node for the link, noting the link is navigation only
The agent does not confuse a canvas group with a directory group
